summary: The new-issue dialog (packages/dispatch/web/src/features/issue/CreateIssueDialog.tsx) gains a RelatedItems section fed by a new api.relatedItems GET (title only) to /api/v1/projects/{key}/related, debounced 400 ms, keyed on [related, project, debouncedTitle], aborted when superseded, and shown only while the debounced title equals the box's title; it renders the CLI's three forms (found list, searched-nothing, not made with the search words), the past decision, and a request failure, each item a new-tab link named by its owner label with ask state from an AskHitStatus extracted from SearchPalette.tsx.
decisions: GET with the title only: a title is at most 1000 UTF-16 units (ISSUE_TITLE_MAX, contracts dispatch-api.ts:405), the GET cap (SEARCH_QUERY_MAX, dispatch-tools.ts:296, related_routes.go:51-55); every POST is a keyed write needing an Idempotency-Key (server.go:377).

Every related kind is shown (issue, ask, comment, message, document), as the CLI shows it (envoy-client related-check.ts:101-131); the parent ask's option text said 'issues', this child's spec says 'items'.
Debounce 400 ms, superseded requests aborted via react-query's signal; default (meaning and keywords) mode, since the spec names meaning or rare words.
Stale answers never shown: query keyed on the debounced title and display gated on debounced === current trimmed title and project (SearchPalette.tsx:466-476,512-513 pattern).
Wording mirrors the CLI's three forms, written in the component (the web cannot import @legion/envoy-client); a failed request reads 'Could not check for related items.' with Retry.
Links open in a new tab so the draft survives; accessible name is the owner label only (KEY Title, or document Name).
No request below 2 trimmed characters or with no project selected.
